expectation.text: A bar system monitor (CPU load and temperature, RAM, network up/down, with a pull-down of more detail and a button that opens btop) should report the same numbers btop shows.

payload.observed: btop 1.4.7 has no export, JSON or headless mode (btop --help lists only display options), so a bar widget cannot ask btop for its numbers. Of the options offered (port btop's collector, read a hidden btop's screen, or build a patched btop that exports), the user chose porting the collector; screen-reading would break when btop's layout changes and a patched btop would need rebuilding on every update.
payload.title: Show btop's own CPU, temperature, RAM and network numbers in the Omarchy bar
